purpose: Validate that the old implicit frozen default uses equivalent prediction and calibration behavior when the identical forest is loaded from a training checkpoint or directly from its artifact. This is a validation receipt, not an additional MAPE measurement.
observations: First 256 observations of the Gym's chronological 50% B+C test suffix, in their original order.

configurations.shared: Canonical deployment identity from the checkpoint manifest; estimation_mode=fpm_learned; fallback_policy=deny; all adaptation, correction, online and selector settings omitted.

feedback_schedule: After predicting and comparing each observation, tune both models when its zero-based index is divisible by eight. This small loader-equivalence check deliberately uses its own bounded schedule, not the Gym's five-second accuracy protocol.
metadata_difference: Checkpoint loading verifies canonical deployment identity and includes it in the exported artifact metadata. Direct loading preserves the original artifact metadata. This provenance difference does not alter the numerical forest or correction path.
source_reasoning: Both source branches decode the same artifact with LearnedForwardPassModel::from_json. Frozen adaptation skips OnlineLearner construction and enters the same learned predictor with WorkloadStores correction state. Checkpoint loading additionally validates manifest checksum and deployment identity.
limitation: Thirty-two feedback calls remain below the 64-observation fixed calibration capacity, avoiding randomized eviction ties. Longer independent calibration instances can differ through those ties even when both load the same forest. The result substantiates equivalent old-default behavior, not identical authored source configuration or a new accuracy claim.
